page_title: LEV 3-1 HOF | Bayer Leverkusen v Hoffenheim 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) . He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90+5' The attendance is 29278.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+4' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) offside.

90+3' It's unbelievable, Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards the left post from a few yards out, but Lukas Hradecky reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90+1' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
87' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
84' That's the end of the game for Erencan Yardimci, who is replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
84' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jeremie Frimpong.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
81' The resulting corner from Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

81' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
79' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
79' Booking. Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) receives a caution from the referee.

76' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of David Mokwa Ntusu, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
74' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with David Mokwa Ntusu (Hoffenheim) coming on for Robin Hranac.
72' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
72' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
71' A lofted cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
68' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change due to the red card. Mario Hermoso is brought on as a substitute for Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen).
67' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
66' The corner from Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Luca Philipp.

66' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
62' 3 - 1 Goal! 3:1. The ball rebounds to Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
62' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) replacing Marius Bulter.
62' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. David Jurasek is replaced by Hennes Behrens (Hoffenheim).
62' Substitution. Dennis Geiger will be replaced by Gift Orban (Hoffenheim).
61' Sending-off! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sees a second yellow card, followed by a red, and won't take part in the rest of the game.
59' A pass from Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Luca Philipp and the move breaks down.

55' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Luca Philipp is alert and denies him with a nice save.
54' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

51' 3 - 0 Emiliano Buendia fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box. He unleashes a quick shot into the top left corner. The score is 3:0.
51' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

50' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.

48' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies well over the crossbar.
47' Robin Braun blows his whistle and signals a foul after Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) brought his opponent down. Hoffenheim get a free kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) and Victor Boniface is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

45+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

45+1' Florian Wirtz nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
44' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends a long cross over to Erencan Yardimci, but Lukas Hradecky comes forward to gather the ball.
42' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is substituted due to injury. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Emiliano Buendia.

42' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Lukas Hradecky. What a save!
40' It doesn’t look good for Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
39' The game is interrupted now, Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' The foul by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Robin Braun who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
34' Big chance! A simple pass from David Jurasek left Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:0. Shots on target – 2:0.
31' That's a well-taken pass by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
30' Bayer Leverkusen string together a series of short passes.
28' Robin Braun blows his whistle after Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
25' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and Robin Braun immediately signals a free kick.
25' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
24' NO PENALTY! Referee Robin Braun has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Bayer Leverkusen players are incensed.
22' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
22' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) brings his opponent down. Robin Braun has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is given to Bayer Leverkusen!
20' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Luca Philipp comes off his line to gather the ball.

19' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Aleix Garcia, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), who beats Luca Philipp with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
17' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
16' The total number of attempts is 1:1. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.

15' 1 - 0 Goal Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen)! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) was put through by Alejandro Grimaldo and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 1:0.

13' Erencan Yardimci almost found himself in a promising position after Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
11' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
10' Half-chance! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Luca Philipp reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' Robin Braun blows his whistle and it's Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
4' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

4' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robin Braun saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
3' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Luca Philipp, who smothers the ball.
2' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

1' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Good work from Bayer Leverkusen as they win a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
